steps.say: Cut the avocados in half lengthwise around the pit.
steps.done_when: avocado halves visible, cut faces up

steps.say: Remove the pits and scoop the flesh into the bowl.
steps.done_when: green flesh in bowl, empty skins

steps.say: Mash the avocado with a fork, leave it a bit chunky.
Finely dice about a quarter of an onion.
Dice one tomato and add it with the onion.
Squeeze in half a lime and add a pinch of salt.
Chop some cilantro, add it, and stir everything together.
